ASAM UI PRO

列表与任务卡片

以纵向、网格或卡片方式展示同一列表模型。

使用与 API

  • 高级列表 · AsamProList：用纵向或网格布局展示列表查询结果。
  • 卡片列表 · AsamCardList：把列表结果按网格或瀑布流排列，支持封面与当前页选择。
  • Pro 任务卡片 · AsamProTaskCard：在卡片分组内展示任务状态、负责人、进度与操作。

完整示例

高级列表

列表内容

content 把行数据映射到展示内容。

列表内容

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack">
		<AsamProList :controller="controller" :content="content" label="项目列表" />
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamProList } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string };
const records: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	status: '进行中'
}));
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', kind: 'text' }],
	initial: { name: '' },
	api: async (request) => {
		const rows = records.filter((row) => row.name.includes(String(request.query.name || '')));
		return {
			list: rows.slice(
				(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
				request.currentPage * request.pageSize
			),
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const columns = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号' },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称' },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态' }
] as const;

const content = (row: Row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.status });
</script>

场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '列表内容 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '列表内容 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/ts', label: '选择与尺寸 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/js', label: '选择与尺寸 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>
<style scoped>
.component-project {
	display: grid;
	gap: 24px;
	padding: 24px;
}
.component-project label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
}
.component-project .asam-select {
	width: min(100%, 420px);
}
</style>

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack">
		<AsamProList :controller="controller" :content="content" label="项目列表" />
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamProList } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string };
const records: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	status: '进行中'
}));
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称', kind: 'text' }],
	initial: { name: '' },
	api: async (request) => {
		const rows = records.filter((row) => row.name.includes(String(request.query.name || '')));
		return {
			list: rows.slice(
				(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
				request.currentPage * request.pageSize
			),
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const columns = [
	{ key: 'id', label: '编号' },
	{ key: 'name', label: '项目名称' },
	{ key: 'status', label: '状态' }
] as const;

const content = (row: Row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.status });
</script>

# AsamProList 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

卡片列表

卡片布局与容器宽度

用查询卡片应用布局选项，拖动列表右侧手柄调整宽度。滚动到列表底部加载更多项目，部分封面会在项目加载后显示。

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">
		<AsamSearchForm
			v-model="draft"
			:fields="fields"
			:reset-values="defaultQuery"
			@submit="applyQuery"
			@reset="applyQuery"
		/>
		<div ref="previewHost" class="card-preview-host">
			<div
				class="card-layout-preview"
				:style="{ maxWidth: previewWidth === undefined ? undefined : previewWidth + 'px' }"
			>
				<div
					v-if="cardType === 'projects'"
					v-asam-infinite-scroll="loadMore"
					:infinite-scroll-disabled="scrollDisabled"
					:infinite-scroll-distance="24"
					:infinite-scroll-immediate="false"
				>
					<AsamCardList
						class="card-layout-content"
						:controller="controller"
						:content="content"
						:layout="layout"
						:columns="columnMode"
						:card-size="cardSize"
						:gap="gap"
						selectable
						hide-refresh
						hide-ready-status
						hide-pagination
						:label="layout === 'masonry' ? '项目进展瀑布流' : '项目卡片列表'"
					>
						<template #error="{ message }">
							<div v-if="readMode === 'first'" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
								{{ message }}
								<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
						<template #meta="{ row }">
							<AsamTag
								:type="row.status === '已完成' ? 'success' : 'info'"
								effect="light"
							>
								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:press-animation="false"
					aria-label="调整容器宽度"
					title="拖动调整宽度，方向键微调"
					@pointerdown="beginResize"
					@pointermove="resizePreview"
					@lostpointercapture="dragOrigin = undefined"
					@keydown.left.prevent="nudgePreview(-10)"
					@keydown.right.prevent="nudgePreview(10)"
				>
					<MoreFilled class="card-preview-handle-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer
			:model-value="!!active"
			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"
			@update:model-value="close"
		>
			<p v-if="active">
				<strong>{{ active.name }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p v-if="active">{{ active.description }}</p>
		</AsamDrawer>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);

const baseFields = [

	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }

	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [

];

	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),

	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)

	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',

		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'

	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

		if (failNextRead) {

}

	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

function applyQuery(query: AsamFieldModel) {

	const columns = query.columnMode;

	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);

	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;

		cardSize.value = {

			maxWidth:

					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))

			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),

	);

	description: row.description,

	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'

		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay, signal) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});
function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});
function applyQuery(query) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);
	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}
	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AsamCardList, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { AsamRadioButton, AsamRadioGroup, createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardPreset } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef } from 'vue';
type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string };
const records: Row[] = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	status: '进行中'
}));
const presets: readonly AsamCardPreset[] = ['small', 'default', 'big', 'large'];
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardPreset>('default');
function setCardSize(value: unknown) {
	const preset = presets.find((item) => item === value);
	if (preset) cardSize.value = preset;
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	pageSize: 20,
	api: async (request) => {
		return {
			list: records.slice(
				(request.currentPage - 1) * request.pageSize,
				request.currentPage * request.pageSize
			),
			total: records.length
		};
	}
});

const content = (row: Row) => ({ title: row.name, description: row.status });
onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());
</script>

<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">

						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);

		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '卡片布局与容器宽度 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '卡片布局与容器宽度 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/ts', label: '选择与尺寸 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'selection/js', label: '选择与尺寸 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'masonry/ts', label: '瀑布流 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'masonry/js', label: '瀑布流 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'selection/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/selection/js/Demo.vue')),
	'masonry/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/masonry/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'masonry/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/masonry/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>
<style scoped>
.component-project {

}
.component-project .asam-select {
	width: min(100%, 420px);
}
</style>

vue
<template>
	<div class="pro-example-stack card-list-demo">
		<AsamSearchForm
			v-model="draft"
			:fields="fields"
			:reset-values="defaultQuery"
			@submit="applyQuery"
			@reset="applyQuery"
		/>
		<div ref="previewHost" class="card-preview-host">
			<div
				class="card-layout-preview"
				:style="{ maxWidth: previewWidth === undefined ? undefined : previewWidth + 'px' }"
			>
				<div
					v-if="cardType === 'projects'"
					v-asam-infinite-scroll="loadMore"
					:infinite-scroll-disabled="scrollDisabled"
					:infinite-scroll-distance="24"
					:infinite-scroll-immediate="false"
				>
					<AsamCardList
						class="card-layout-content"
						:controller="controller"
						:content="content"
						:layout="layout"
						:columns="columnMode"
						:card-size="cardSize"
						:gap="gap"
						selectable
						hide-refresh
						hide-ready-status
						hide-pagination
						:label="layout === 'masonry' ? '项目进展瀑布流' : '项目卡片列表'"
					>
						<template #error="{ message }">
							<div v-if="readMode === 'first'" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
								{{ message }}
								<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
						<template #meta="{ row }">
							<AsamTag
								:type="row.status === '已完成' ? 'success' : 'info'"
								effect="light"
							>
								{{ row.status }}
							</AsamTag>
						</template>
						<template #operation="{ row }">
							<div class="card-footer">
								<time :datetime="row.updatedAt">
									{{ updatedLabel(row.updatedAt) }}
								</time>
								<AsamButton
									size="small"
									type="primary"
									plain
									:disabled="!controller.resultReady.value"
									v-bind="detailLabel(row.name)"
									@click="active = row"
								>
									查看详情
								</AsamButton>
							</div>
						</template>
					</AsamCardList>
					<div v-if="appendFailed" class="card-load-error" role="alert">
						加载更多项目失败
						<AsamButton size="small" @click="retry">重试</AsamButton>
					</div>
					<p v-else class="card-load-status" role="status">{{ scrollStatus }}</p>
				</div>
				<AsamCardGroup
					class="card-layout-content"
					v-else
					label="不同类型的卡片"
					:layout="layout"
					:columns="columnMode"
					:card-size="cardSize"
					:gap="gap"
				>
					<AsamDisplayCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'status'"
						title="状态卡片"
						description="交付检查"
					>
						<AsamTag type="success" effect="light">已核验</AsamTag>
						<p>测试环境和交付资料已检查。</p>
					</AsamDisplayCard>
					<AsamProTaskCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'task'"
						title="任务卡片"
						description="整理验收记录和操作说明"
						:status="{ label: '进行中', tone: 'info' }"
						:assignees="[{ id: 1, name: '林悦' }]"
						:progress="65"
					/>
					<AsamStatisticCard
						v-if="cardType === 'all' || cardType === 'statistic'"
						title="指标卡片"
						label="本月已交付项目"
						:value="18"
						:precision="0"
						unit="项"
						helper="按已完成验收的项目统计"
					/>
				</AsamCardGroup>
				<AsamButton
					class="card-preview-handle"
					type="primary"
					plain
					:press-animation="false"
					aria-label="调整容器宽度"
					title="拖动调整宽度，方向键微调"
					@pointerdown="beginResize"
					@pointermove="resizePreview"
					@lostpointercapture="dragOrigin = undefined"
					@keydown.left.prevent="nudgePreview(-10)"
					@keydown.right.prevent="nudgePreview(10)"
				>
					<MoreFilled class="card-preview-handle-icon" aria-hidden="true" />
				</AsamButton>
			</div>
		</div>
		<AsamDrawer
			:model-value="!!active"
			title="项目详情"
			size="min(440px, 100vw)"
			@update:model-value="close"
		>
			<p v-if="active">
				<strong>{{ active.name }}</strong>
			</p>
			<p v-if="active">{{ active.description }}</p>
		</AsamDrawer>
	</div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import {
	AsamButton,
	AsamDrawer,
	AsamInfiniteScroll as vAsamInfiniteScroll,
	AsamTag,
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamCardSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { MoreFilled } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
import {
	AsamCardGroup,
	AsamCardList,
	AsamDisplayCard,
	AsamProTaskCard,
	AsamSearchForm,
	AsamStatisticCard,
	createAsamNumberField,
	useAsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type {
	AsamFieldDefinition,
	AsamFieldModel,
	AsamListController
} from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';

defineProps<{ layout: 'grid' | 'masonry' }>();

type Row = { id: number; name: string; status: string; description: string; updatedAt: string };

const cardTypes = {
	projects: '项目列表',
	all: '全部卡片类型',
	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {
	small: 'small',
	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',
	custom: '自定义'
};
const states = { ready: '正常', loading: '加载中', empty: '无结果', error: '读取失败' };
const defaultGeometry = {
	minWidth: 240,
	maxWidth: 360,
	minHeight: 0,
	padding: 16,
	titleFontSize: 16,
	bodyFontSize: 13,
	contentGap: 10
};
const defaultQuery = {
	cardType: 'projects',
	columnMode: 'auto',
	preset: 'default',
	gap: 16,
	state: 'ready',
	limitWidth: 'auto',
	...defaultGeometry
} as const;
const draft = shallowRef<AsamFieldModel>({ ...defaultQuery });
const cardType = shallowRef<keyof typeof cardTypes>(defaultQuery.cardType);
const columnMode = shallowRef<'auto' | 2 | 3 | 4>(defaultQuery.columnMode);
const cardSize = shallowRef<AsamCardSize>(defaultQuery.preset);
const state = shallowRef<keyof typeof states>(defaultQuery.state);
const gap = shallowRef<number>(defaultQuery.gap);
const previewWidth = shallowRef<number>();
const previewHost = shallowRef<HTMLElement>();
const availableWidth = shallowRef(0);
let dragOrigin: { pointerId: number; x: number; width: number } | undefined;
let hostObserver: ResizeObserver | undefined;
const detailLabel = (name: string) => ({ 'aria-label': '查看详情：' + name });

function choiceField(
	key: string,
	label: string,
	options: readonly { value: string | number; label: string }[]
): AsamFieldDefinition {
	return {
		key,
		label,
		kind: 'single',
		source: defineAsamOptions().static({ options }),
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { clearable: false } } }
	};
}
function labeledChoices(labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>>) {
	return Object.entries(labels).map(([value, label]) => ({ value, label }));
}
function numberField(key: string, label: string, min: number, max: number) {
	return createAsamNumberField({
		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,
		modes: { query: { componentProps: { min, max } } }
	});
}
function numericValue(value: unknown, fallback: number) {
	return typeof value === 'number' ? value : fallback;
}
function isChoice<T extends string>(value: unknown, labels: Record<T, string>): value is T {
	return typeof value === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(labels, value);
}

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }
	])
];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');
const widthLimit = computed(() => draft.value.limitWidth === 'limited');
const minimumWidth = computed(() =>
	Math.min(numericValue(draft.value.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth), 1200)
);
const fields = computed<readonly AsamFieldDefinition[]>(() => {
	const visibleFields = [...baseFields];
	if (projectQuery.value) visibleFields.push(stateField);
	if (customSize.value) {
		visibleFields.push(...widthFields);
		if (widthLimit.value)
			visibleFields.push(numberField('maxWidth', '最大卡宽', minimumWidth.value, 1600));
		visibleFields.push(...geometryFields);
	}
	return visibleFields;
});

onMounted(() => {
	const host = previewHost.value;
	if (!host) return;
	const measure = () => (availableWidth.value = host.clientWidth);
	measure();
	if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
		hostObserver = new ResizeObserver(measure);
		hostObserver.observe(host);
	}
});

function setPreviewWidth(width: number) {
	const available = availableWidth.value;
	if (!available) return;
	const minimum = Math.min(240, available);
	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event: PointerEvent) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta: number) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef<Row>();
const readMode = shallowRef<'first' | 'append'>('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index: number): Row => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]!
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}

const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller: AsamListController<Row> = useAsamListController<Row>({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});

const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});

function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}

watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});

function applyQuery(query: AsamFieldModel) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);

	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}

	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row: Row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value: string) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open: boolean) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

<script setup>
import {
	AsamButton,

	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }

	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }

];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)

const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');

	description: [

		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'

import { AsamCardList, useAsamListController } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

}

	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],

			list: records.slice(

			total: records.length
		};
	}

onBeforeUnmount(() => runtime.invalidate());

	status: '状态卡片',
	task: '任务卡片',
	statistic: '指标卡片'
};
const presets = {

	default: 'default',
	big: 'big',
	large: 'large',

};

		key,
		label,
		min,
		max,

const baseFields = [
	choiceField('cardType', '卡片类型', labeledChoices(cardTypes)),
	choiceField('columnMode', '列数', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '自动' },
		{ value: 2, label: '两列' },
		{ value: 3, label: '三列' },
		{ value: 4, label: '四列' }
	]),
	choiceField('preset', '卡片尺寸', labeledChoices(presets)),
	numberField('gap', '间距', 0, 48)
];
const stateField = choiceField('state', '内容状态', labeledChoices(states));
const widthFields = [
	numberField('minWidth', '最小卡宽', 120, 1200),
	choiceField('limitWidth', '限制最大卡宽', [
		{ value: 'auto', label: '不限' },
		{ value: 'limited', label: '限制' }

];
const geometryFields = [
	numberField('minHeight', '最小高度', 0, 900),
	numberField('padding', '内边距', 0, 60),
	numberField('titleFontSize', '标题字号', 12, 30),
	numberField('bodyFontSize', '正文字号', 12, 24),
	numberField('contentGap', '内容间距', 0, 40)
];
const projectQuery = computed(() => draft.value.cardType === 'projects');
const customSize = computed(() => draft.value.preset === 'custom');

	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3]!,
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]!
});

	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

		if (failNextRead) {

	previewWidth.value = width >= available ? undefined : Math.max(minimum, width);
}
function currentPreviewWidth() {
	return Math.min(previewWidth.value ?? availableWidth.value, availableWidth.value);
}
function beginResize(event) {
	if (event.button !== 0 || dragOrigin || !(event.currentTarget instanceof HTMLElement)) return;
	dragOrigin = { pointerId: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, width: currentPreviewWidth() };
	event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
}
function resizePreview(event) {
	if (dragOrigin?.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
	setPreviewWidth(dragOrigin.width + event.clientX - dragOrigin.x);
}
function nudgePreview(delta) {
	setPreviewWidth(currentPreviewWidth() + delta);
}
const active = shallowRef();
const readMode = shallowRef('first');
const coverThrough = shallowRef(0);
let coverTimer;
let failNextRead = false;
const createRow = (index) => ({
	id: index + 1,
	name: '项目 ' + (index + 1),
	updatedAt: '2026-11-' + String((index % 11) + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
	status: ['进行中', '已完成', '待确认'][index % 3],
	description: [
		'项目范围已确认。',
		'正在整理阶段成果，涉及范围核对、进度跟踪和后续验收。',
		'等待下一轮评审。团队已整理需求、交互、实现及用户复测记录，确认后安排后续交付。'
	][index % 3]
});
const records = Array.from({ length: 37 }, (_, index) => createRow(index));
function waitForResponse(delay, signal) {
	return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		const cancel = () => {
			clearTimeout(timer);
			reject(signal.reason);
		};
		const timer = setTimeout(() => {
			signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
			resolve();
		}, delay);
		signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
	});
}
const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime();
const controller = useAsamListController({
	runtime,
	rowKey: 'id',
	fields: [],
	initial: {},
	api: async ({ pageSize }, { signal }) => {
		const current = state.value;
		const append = readMode.value === 'append';
		const previous = append ? controller.page.data.value.list : [];
		const offset = previous.length;
		await waitForResponse(append ? 550 : current === 'loading' ? 1000 : 220, signal);
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failNextRead) {
			failNextRead = false;
			throw new Error('示例读取失败');
		}
		const rows = current === 'empty' ? [] : records;
		return {
			list: [...previous, ...rows.slice(offset, offset + pageSize)],
			total: rows.length
		};
	}
});
const page = controller.page;
const loadedCount = computed(() => page.data.value.list.length);
const hasMore = computed(() => loadedCount.value < page.data.value.total);
const scrollDisabled = computed(
	() => cardType.value !== 'projects' || !controller.resultReady.value || !hasMore.value
);
const appendFailed = computed(() => readMode.value === 'append' && !!page.error.value);
const scrollStatus = computed(() => {
	if (readMode.value === 'append' && page.loading.value) return '正在加载更多项目…';
	if (!controller.resultReady.value || !loadedCount.value) return '';
	return hasMore.value ? '继续滚动加载更多项目' : '已加载全部项目';
});
function loadMore() {
	if (scrollDisabled.value) return;
	readMode.value = 'append';
	// 重读当前结果快照，保留已选行，追加来源的下一批记录。
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
function retry() {
	if (page.loading.value || !page.error.value) return;
	void page.reload({ force: true });
}
watch(page.data, ({ list }) => {
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	const lastId = list.at(-1)?.id ?? 0;
	if (lastId > coverThrough.value) {
		coverTimer = setTimeout(() => (coverThrough.value = lastId), 650);
	}
});
function applyQuery(query) {
	const previousType = cardType.value;
	cardType.value = isChoice(query.cardType, cardTypes) ? query.cardType : defaultQuery.cardType;
	const columns = query.columnMode;
	columnMode.value = columns === 2 || columns === 3 || columns === 4 ? columns : 'auto';
	gap.value = numericValue(query.gap, defaultQuery.gap);
	const preset = isChoice(query.preset, presets) ? query.preset : defaultQuery.preset;
	if (preset === 'custom') {
		const minWidth = numericValue(query.minWidth, defaultGeometry.minWidth);
		cardSize.value = {
			minWidth,
			maxWidth:
				query.limitWidth === 'limited'
					? Math.max(minWidth, numericValue(query.maxWidth, defaultGeometry.maxWidth))
					: undefined,
			minHeight: numericValue(query.minHeight, defaultGeometry.minHeight),
			padding: numericValue(query.padding, defaultGeometry.padding),
			titleFontSize: numericValue(query.titleFontSize, defaultGeometry.titleFontSize),
			bodyFontSize: numericValue(query.bodyFontSize, defaultGeometry.bodyFontSize),
			contentGap: numericValue(query.contentGap, defaultGeometry.contentGap)
		};
	} else {
		cardSize.value = preset;
	}
	if (cardType.value !== 'projects') {
		if (previousType === 'projects') {
			page.cancel();
			clearTimeout(coverTimer);
			active.value = undefined;
		}
		return;
	}
	const nextState = isChoice(query.state, states) ? query.state : defaultQuery.state;
	if (
		previousType === 'projects' &&
		state.value === nextState &&
		nextState !== 'error' &&
		nextState !== 'loading'
	)
		return;
	page.cancel();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	coverThrough.value = 0;
	active.value = undefined;
	readMode.value = 'first';
	state.value = nextState;
	failNextRead = nextState === 'error';
	void controller.submit();
}
const media =
	'data:image/svg+xml,' +
	encodeURIComponent(
		'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160"><rect width="400" height="160" fill="#e4f0ff"/><path d="M0 152l108-104 72 66 62-46 158 92H0Z" fill="#73a9ec"/><circle cx="290" cy="55" r="22" fill="#ffd089"/></svg>'
	);
const content = (row) => ({
	title: row.name,
	description: row.description,
	cover:
		row.id % 3 === 1 || (row.id <= coverThrough.value && row.id % 3 === 2)
			? { src: media, alt: row.name + '封面' }
			: undefined
});
const formatDate = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('zh-CN', {
	month: 'long',
	day: 'numeric',
	timeZone: 'UTC'
});
const updatedLabel = (value) => formatDate.format(new Date(value)) + '更新';
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	hostObserver?.disconnect();
	clearTimeout(coverTimer);
	runtime.invalidate();
});
function close(open) {
	if (!open) active.value = undefined;
}
</script>

# AsamCardList 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

Pro 任务卡片

任务信息

标题和状态在头部单行显示，日期与操作在底部单行显示。正文可用纯文字、纯图片，或按需要排列图文。

<template>
	<AsamCardGroup label="任务卡片列表">
		<AsamProTaskCard
			v-for="card in cards"
			:key="card.title"
			:title="card.title"
			:status="card.status"
			:progress="card.progress"
		>
			<template v-for="block in card.content" :key="block.type">
				<img
					v-if="block.type === 'image'"
					:src="cover"
					alt="蓝色山景项目封面"
					width="160"
					height="60"
				/>
				<p v-else>{{ block.text }}</p>
			</template>
			<template #footer-meta>
				<time datetime="2026-01-01">2026-01-01</time>
			</template>
			<template #operation="{ blocked }">
				<AsamButton
					type="primary"
					plain
					:disabled="blocked"
					:aria-label="'查看详情：' + card.title"
					@click="activeTask = card"
				>
					查看详情
				</AsamButton>
			</template>
		</AsamProTaskCard>
	</AsamCardGroup>
	<AsamDrawer
		:model-value="activeTask !== null"
		:title="activeTask?.title"
		@update:model-value="closeDetails"
	>
		<p v-if="activeTask">{{ activeTask.status.label }}</p>
	</AsamDrawer>
</template>

import { shallowRef } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTaskStatus } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

defineOptions({ name: 'TaskStatusesExample' });

interface Task {
	title: string;
	status: AsamTaskStatus;
	progress?: number;
	content: readonly ({ type: 'image' } | { type: 'text'; text: string })[];
}

const cover =
	'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAKAAAAA8CAMAAADWtUEnAAAADFBMVEXb6v14qN5Rh8X/x4M61bGIAAAA8UlEQVR42u3SsW0EQQDDwCO3/54d2Mk7poDF41iAMIGe5+3t7e1LO79dzruWeM7dwnMuF94OPOdy4Qu8F8jlQOBqIETCERBWwtSXCBdAmAlrXy3sfdUPHfyvFKrPM/IVQs2EMBBqJoSBUDMhDISaCWEg1EwIA6FmQhgINRPCQKiZEAZCzYQwEGomhIFQMyEMhJoJYSDUTAgDoWZCGAg1E8JAqJkQBkLNhDAQaiaEgVAzIQyEmglhINRMCAOhZkIYCDUTwkComRAGQs2EMBBqJoSBUDMhDISaCTMfJr7/QkKgie9TSAo08f3NkGfaC/x64A/e3RVRswqz9gAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==';

const cards: readonly Task[] = [
	{
		title: '完善项目说明、交付范围和后续验收计划',
		status: { label: '进行中', tone: 'primary' },
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '补充目标、排期和成员信息。' }]
	},
	{
		title: '项目封面',
		status: { label: '通过验收', tone: 'success', completed: true },
		content: [{ type: 'image' }]
	},
	{
		title: '巡检记录',
		status: { label: '待处理', tone: 'warning' },
		content: [{ type: 'image' }, { type: 'text', text: '补充巡检结果与现场记录。' }]
	},
	{
		title: '复核交付资料',
		status: { label: '已拒绝', tone: 'danger' },
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '请根据反馈更新并重新提交。' }, { type: 'image' }]
	},
	{
		title: '梳理协作进度',
		status: { label: '未分类', tone: 'info' },
		progress: 65,
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '对照排期核对当前进展。' }]
	},
	{
		title: '兼容中性',
		status: { label: '兼容中性', tone: 'neutral' },
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '整理任务说明和交付记录。' }]
	}
];
const activeTask = shallowRef<Task | null>(null);

function closeDetails(open: boolean): void {
	if (!open) activeTask.value = null;
}

		status: { label: '通过验收', tone: 'success', completed: true },
		content: [{ type: 'image' }]
	},
	{
		title: '巡检记录',
		status: { label: '待处理', tone: 'warning' },
		content: [{ type: 'image' }, { type: 'text', text: '补充巡检结果与现场记录。' }]
	},
	{
		title: '复核交付资料',
		status: { label: '已拒绝', tone: 'danger' },
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '请根据反馈更新并重新提交。' }, { type: 'image' }]
	},
	{
		title: '梳理协作进度',
		status: { label: '未分类', tone: 'info' },
		progress: 65,
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '对照排期核对当前进展。' }]
	},
	{
		title: '兼容中性',
		status: { label: '兼容中性', tone: 'neutral' },
		content: [{ type: 'text', text: '整理任务说明和交付记录。' }]
	}
];
const activeTask = shallowRef(null);
function closeDetails(open) {
	if (!open) activeTask.value = null;
}
</script>

vue
<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><AsamConfigProvider :button="{ type: 'primary' }"
			><AsamApplicationProvider
				><component :is="current" :key="selected" /></AsamApplicationProvider
		></AsamConfigProvider>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamApplicationProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '任务信息 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '任务信息 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'members/ts', label: '协作成员 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'members/js', label: '协作成员 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'members/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/members/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'members/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/members/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>
<style scoped>
.component-project {
	display: grid;
	gap: 24px;
	padding: 24px;
}
.component-project label {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 12px;
}
.component-project .asam-select {
	width: min(100%, 420px);
}
</style>

<template>
	<AsamCardGroup label="任务卡片列表">
		<AsamProTaskCard
			v-for="card in cards"
			:key="card.title"
			:title="card.title"
			:status="card.status"
			:progress="card.progress"
		>
			<template v-for="block in card.content" :key="block.type">
				<img
					v-if="block.type === 'image'"
					:src="cover"
					alt="蓝色山景项目封面"
					width="160"
					height="60"
				/>
				<p v-else>{{ block.text }}</p>
			</template>
			<template #footer-meta>
				<time datetime="2026-01-01">2026-01-01</time>
			</template>
			<template #operation="{ blocked }">
				<AsamButton
					type="primary"
					plain
					:disabled="blocked"
					:aria-label="'查看详情：' + card.title"
					@click="activeTask = card"
				>
					查看详情
				</AsamButton>
			</template>
		</AsamProTaskCard>
	</AsamCardGroup>
	<AsamDrawer
		:model-value="activeTask !== null"
		:title="activeTask?.title"
		@update:model-value="closeDetails"
	>
		<p v-if="activeTask">{{ activeTask.status.label }}</p>
	</AsamDrawer>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDrawer } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamCardGroup, AsamProTaskCard } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamTaskStatus } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';

defineOptions({ name: 'TaskStatusesExample' });

interface Task {
	title: string;
	status: AsamTaskStatus;
	progress?: number;
	content: readonly ({ type: 'image' } | { type: 'text'; text: string })[];
}

const cover =

# AsamProTaskCard 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

继续接入

快速开始 · 版本与迁移 · AI 开发说明

接口、行为与迁移细节

接口与行为

全部类型由 Types.ts 与 Index.ts 导出。组件无自有请求 expose，操作使用传入 controller。

分页随本视图四档尺寸采用40/36/32/28控件高度。任务卡的打开标题按钮支持窄屏完整换行，仍为独立按钮，Enter/Space打开与内部动作互不混用；无需新增prop或方法。

入口 成员 契约
AsamProList / AsamCardList controller 必填泛型 AsamListController，宿主拥有生命周期
同上 content 必填纯映射 (row: Row) => AsamListContent
同上 label 必填可访问名称
AsamProList / AsamCardList layout ProList 默认 list，CardList 默认 grid；两者均支持 masonry
同上 minWidth 网格最小宽，沿CardGroup默认240/下限120；手机强制一列
同上 size large/big/default/small，默认default
同上 selectable 默认false；当前页checkbox与controller同步
同上 hidePagination 默认 false；设为 true 时隐藏页码和每页条数控件
同上 readonly / disabled 默认false；暂停本视图动作/分页/排序/选择/刷新
同上 actions / rowActions AsamListAction[]，visible/enabled/busyKey/run沿列表控制器
同上 sorts label/value列表，value是AsamListSort或null；未给则无排序控件
AsamListContent title / description 标题必填，说明可选普通文本
同上 meta label/value数组；空值占位
同上 cover src/alt必填，失败回退alt
同上 avatars 026 AsamAvatarItem[]

省略size时沿官方ASAM尺寸上下文继承，无上下文时default。排序与勾选使用AsamSelect和AsamCheckboxItem。可覆盖CSS变量：--asam-list-cover-height（默认140px）、--asam-list-sort-width（默认180px）、--asam-list-focus-width（默认2px）；间距、颜色与边框继续沿ASAM tokens。

列表slots：title、description、meta、cover、content接收{ row, content }；extra、operation接收{ row, controller }；toolbar接收{ controller }；empty无参数；error接收{ message, retry }。row始终是当前controller页行。替换operation后不会自动包装自定义动作。

AsamProTaskCard 类型/默认 行为
title / description string，title必填 普通文本
status AsamTaskStatus，可选 label、tone（neutral/info/success/warning/danger）、completed
state ready/loading/empty/error，默认ready controlled展示；非ready暂停默认动作与打开
errorText / emptyText 可选string 默认加载失败/暂无内容；error有retry按钮
assignees AsamAvatarItem[] 复用头像失败回退
meta AsamListMeta[] 日期等由宿主格式化
progress number/null，可选 未给隐藏，非有限未知，有限钳制
actions AsamTaskAction[] id/label必填；visible默认true，disabled/busy默认false
disabled / readonly boolean，默认false 禁止默认打开、动作及重试
size 四档，默认default ASAM控件尺寸
openLabel string，可选 提供后标题为独立打开按钮，否则纯标题

任务事件：action(id: string)、open()、retry()。没有自动异步返回值消费，没有v-model，没有内部业务变更。任务slots：default内容、status接收{ status }、extra、operation接收{ blocked }。操作slot自行遵守blocked并执行服务器鉴权。

使用说明

AsamProList 提供纵向、网格和瀑布流布局。AsamCardList 默认使用网格布局，可切换到瀑布流。AsamProTaskCard 展示受控任务信息。这些组件复用公开列表控制器、卡片和头像。

Pro 任务卡片使用 AsamProTaskCard 导入和自动解析，基础库任务卡片使用 AsamTaskCard。从旧版 Pro 迁移时，更新导入名称和模板标签即可。

从正常安装的 @asam-ui/ui / @asam-ui/pro 导入，同时加载 Element Plus、UI 和 Pro 样式。

接入与迁移

保留现有 useAsamListController<Row>，把相同 controller 同时传给 AsamSearchForm 和列表。content(row) 只投影显示信息，不替换原始行。旧 AsamProTable 用法保持兼容。布局切换使用同一 AsamProList 的 layout，不重新查询，不清空选择；不要切换组件实例来期待保留 DOM 焦点。

分页、查询提交/重置、排序、刷新、重试均由 controller 处理。草稿不代表提交条件；结果来源公开展示 successfulSource。旧数据保留期间显示 stale，结果与选择动作由 resultReady 门禁暂停；未查询、加载、真正空、错误和作用域失效分别显示。独立操作仍按 controller 的独立 scope。卸载视图只停止自身反馈，不 dispose controller。

canAction 和 runAction 接收当前页真实行引用；run 回调得到 controller 复制的 row/selected 快照，不能依赖对象同一性或修改副本更新原始记录。异步动作结果的本地反馈按 controller/intent/session 及卸载失效；业务回调自己的外部副作用仍由宿主负责。

默认动作反馈只显示本视图发起、且仍属于当前intent/session的结果。列表控制器全局 controller.actionError 不承担刷新意图隔离，新视图不直接展示它；宿主自行读该字段或提供操作slot时应关联自己的上下文。共享的查询状态、选择、分页和busyKey仍来自同一controller。

选择仅当前页，不提供跨页全量选择。无虚拟列表，只渲染 controller 当前页；默认分页最大100。声明 sorts 将排序提交到宿主 API，不做当前页假排序。所有前端显隐、禁用和只读均非服务器鉴权。自定义 operation/toolbar/任务 operation slot 的行为由宿主负责，slot 不是权限或异步保护边界。

为完整静态列表或滚动加载场景设置 hide-pagination。滚动加载时，可在列表的 DOM 外层使用 AsamInfiniteScroll，由宿主读取下一批记录并将已加载记录合并成 controller 的当前结果。示例追加时重读累积结果快照，按行键保留已加载记录的选择。新查询重新读取首批，清空该列表的选择。

任务卡不请求/修改记录，不包含状态机、工作流后端或看板拖拽。状态 label/tone/completed 由宿主映射。动作只发 action(id)，异步执行、重复点击保护和失败恢复由宿主 controlled busy/error 提供。完整示例含字符串素材状态、数值检修状态两种独立映射。

封面以普通 img 的 alt 和失败回退呈现；未提供封面不制造图片。文字按文本渲染，不使用 v-html。metadata 的 null/undefined 显示 —，日期由宿主格式化为文本，组件不猜测时区/非法日期；未提供字段不制造业务事实。进度未提供则隐藏，null/NaN/Infinity 显示未知，有限值钳制0～100。completed 有明确文字。标题打开为独立按钮，卡片容器不可点击，不嵌套按钮。

四档控件 large/big/default/small 为 40/36/32/28，沿用 ASAM tokens。窄屏一列，操作可换行，默认无动画。真实服务与数据量下的交互耗时需由应用评估。

任务状态由宿主明确映射：进行中primary，已完成/启用success，等待/待处理warning，失败/拒绝danger，中性info；legacy neutral也为中性。completed不根据label自动推断，自定义status slot保留。

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { VNode, VNodeChild } from 'vue';
import type { AsamCardSize, AsamControlSize, AsamCssSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamListAction, AsamListController, AsamListSort } from '../list/Types.js';
import type { AsamAvatarItem, AsamDisplayStatus } from '../display/cards/Types.js';

export interface AsamListMeta {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: string | number | null | undefined;
}
export interface AsamListContent {
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description?: string;
	readonly meta?: readonly AsamListMeta[];
	readonly cover?: { readonly src: string; readonly alt: string };
	readonly avatars?: readonly AsamAvatarItem[];
}
export interface AsamProListProps<Row extends object> {
	readonly controller: AsamListController<Row>;
	readonly content: (row: Row) => AsamListContent;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly layout?: 'list' | 'grid' | 'masonry';
	readonly minWidth?: number;
	readonly cardSize?: AsamCardSize;
	readonly columns?: 'auto' | number;
	readonly maxWidth?: AsamCssSize;
	readonly gap?: AsamCssSize;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	readonly selectable?: boolean;
	/** 隐藏工具栏中的刷新按钮，错误状态仍可重试。 */
	readonly hideRefresh?: boolean;
	/** 隐藏正常结果的就绪提示，保留加载、空结果和错误提示。 */
	readonly hideReadyStatus?: boolean;
	/** 隐藏内置页码和每页条数控件，加载及累积结果由宿主管理。 */
	readonly hidePagination?: boolean;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly actions?: readonly AsamListAction<Row>[];
	readonly rowActions?: readonly AsamListAction<Row>[];
	/** 只提交声明的远程排序，不在当前页本地排序。 */
	readonly sorts?: readonly { readonly label: string; readonly value: AsamListSort | null }[];
}
export interface AsamProListSlots<Row extends object> {
	title?: (scope: { row: Row; content: AsamListContent }) => VNodeChild;
	description?: (scope: { row: Row; content: AsamListContent }) => VNodeChild;
	meta?: (scope: { row: Row; content: AsamListContent }) => VNodeChild;
	cover?: (scope: { row: Row; content: AsamListContent }) => VNodeChild;
	content?: (scope: { row: Row; content: AsamListContent }) => VNodeChild;
	extra?: (scope: { row: Row; controller: AsamListController<Row> }) => VNodeChild;
	operation?: (scope: { row: Row; controller: AsamListController<Row> }) => VNodeChild;
	toolbar?: (scope: { controller: AsamListController<Row> }) => VNodeChild;
	empty?: () => VNodeChild;
	error?: (scope: { message: string; retry: () => void }) => VNodeChild;
}
export type AsamCardListProps<Row extends object> = Omit<AsamProListProps<Row>, 'layout'> & {
	readonly layout?: 'grid' | 'masonry';
};
export interface AsamProTaskCardEmits {
	action: [id: string];
	open: [];
	retry: [];
}
export interface AsamProTaskCardSlots {
	/** 主体内容按插槽顺序显示，直接提供的图片占满内容区。 */
	default?: () => VNode[];
	status?: (scope: { status?: AsamTaskStatus }) => VNode[];
	extra?: () => VNode[];
	/** 底部行首的日期或其他简短信息。 */
	'footer-meta'?: () => VNode[];
	operation?: (scope: { blocked: boolean }) => VNode[];
}
export interface AsamTaskStatus {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly tone?: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'primary' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger';
	readonly completed?: boolean;
}
export interface AsamTaskAction {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly label: string;
	readonly visible?: boolean;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly busy?: boolean;
}
export interface AsamProTaskCardProps {
	readonly title: string;
	readonly description?: string;
	readonly status?: AsamTaskStatus;
	readonly state?: AsamDisplayStatus;
	readonly errorText?: string;
	readonly emptyText?: string;
	readonly assignees?: readonly AsamAvatarItem[];
	readonly meta?: readonly AsamListMeta[];
	/** 0～100，非有限值显示“进度未知”，越界值钳制。 */
	readonly progress?: number | null;
	readonly actions?: readonly AsamTaskAction[];
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
	readonly readonly?: boolean;
	readonly size?: AsamControlSize;
	/** 独立标题按钮；卡片容器不响应点击。 */
	readonly openLabel?: string;
}
